beats.say: Brazil is bigger than the mainland United States.
beats.title: BRAZIL IS BIGGER THAN THE USA

beats.say: Drop it on America at true size.
Brazil covers eight and a half million square kilometers. The lower forty eight states, about eight point one.
It touches ten countries. Every country in South America, except two: Chile and Ecuador.
And about sixty percent of the Amazon rainforest is inside Brazil.
A country the size of a continent. Follow for more.
beats.title: A COUNTRY THE SIZE OF A CONTINENT
